prompt: Compare your two runs. What did the secure run return?
options: 1 row, whichever row came first in the table
asserts: you can tell scoping a request apart from refusing it, from your own runs
pass_message: Right. Identity does not refuse the request; it narrows it to the person signed in. Compare the SQL injection fix, which refused the call outright.
fail_message: Read the SQL line in your secure run: it names the customer_id it used and how many rows came back.
